verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB's docs say it speaks the native ClickHouse protocol and HTTP interface, so every ClickHouse client and driver connects unchanged. They also say any BI or dashboard tool that connects to ClickHouse works, naming Grafana, Metabase, Superset, Tableau and DBeaver, with no custom glue. Missing for 10: explicit mention of JDBC/ODBC drivers, per-tool connection guides for the named BI integrations, independent or hands-on corroboration that dashboards connect unchanged.
